description: Angular component for managing router tabs in the Thingsboard UI, including tab building, route handling, and dynamic header component rendering.

classes.name: RouterTabsComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending PageComponent, managing dynamic routing tabs and header components.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes tab data streams and header component based on route data.

methods.name: activeComponentChanged
methods.description: Updates active component state and manages tab visibility based on route hierarchy.

methods.name: getSectionPath
methods.description: Constructs route section path from ActivatedRoute.

methods.name: buildTabs
methods.description: Builds tab list based on current route and menu sections.

methods.name: buildTabsForRoutes
methods.description: Builds tab list for route-configured children, considering user authority.

methods.name: findRootSection
methods.description: Recursively finds root menu section matching a route path.

methods.name: buildTabsHeaderComponent
methods.description: Dynamically creates header component for tabs based on route data.
